note: A real byte-truncated `codex debug models` stdout: the JSON is cut off partway through the second catalog entry. It is stored as a JSON string rather than as a literally malformed .json file because `biome check` parses every JSON file in this repository and a malformed one would fail that gate before any test ran. The test feeds `stdout` to the parser verbatim, so the parser still sees the exact truncated bytes.
